description: This source file implements Open vSwitch (OVS) related actions for network bridge, VLAN, GRE, and port management, including setup, modification, and flow configuration, with device-specific handling and security considerations.

methods.name: SetModelNum
methods.description: Sets device model number in configuration based on input string.

methods.name: SetOneWifiEnabled
methods.description: Sets the OneWifiEnabled flag in configuration.

methods.name: getVlanFromInterfaceName
methods.description: Extracts VLAN ID from interface name string.

methods.name: setupAndRestoreEthSwitchCmds
methods.description: Configures and restores Ethernet switch port settings.

methods.name: setupEthSwitchCmds
methods.description: Sets up Ethernet switch commands for a given interface.

methods.name: ovs_setupEthSwitch
methods.description: Handles special setup for Intel Puma7 Ethernet switch ports.

methods.name: GetLan0IPAddess
methods.description: Retrieves LAN0 IP address via syscfg.

methods.name: ovs_setup_admin_gui_access
methods.description: Configures OpenFlow flows for admin GUI access in bridge mode.

methods.name: ovs_block_mso_ui_access
methods.description: Blocks MSO UI access from LAN clients in bridge mode.

methods.name: ovs_setup_brcm_wifi_flows
methods.description: Sets up Broadcom WiFi related OpenFlow rules.

methods.name: ovs_createBridge
methods.description: Creates or deletes an OVS bridge.

methods.name: ovs_createGRE
methods.description: Creates or deletes GRE tunnel interfaces.

methods.name: ovs_addPort
methods.description: Adds or removes ports to/from bridges.

methods.name: ovs_action_init
methods.description: Initializes OVS action module with device model and environment settings.

methods.name: update_openflow_priority_conf
methods.description: Updates OpenFlow priority configuration for specific interfaces.

methods.name: ovs_action_gateway_config
methods.description: Main entry point for configuring network interfaces based on request.
